plus_subheading: Study smarter, not longer. Plus tracks how well you know each word and shows you only the cards worth reviewing today — so every session actually sticks.

plus_feature_1_title: Study only what you need today
plus_feature_1_body: The app tracks which words you find easy and which ones you keep forgetting. Each day it shows you only the cards worth reviewing — so you spend less time and remember more.
plus_feature_2_body: Unlock all vocabulary categories from B1 through C2 — over 60 topic areas covering politics, law, medicine, literature, and more.
plus_feature_3_body: Your review history follows you across phone, tablet, and desktop. Never lose your progress when switching devices.
plus_feature_4_body: All eight B1 exam-essential categories unlocked, including Work, Housing, Finance, and Healthcare — the topics that appear most on the citizenship test.
plus_how_body_1: After you flip a card, you tap how well you remembered it — Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. The app uses that feedback to figure out the best time to show you that card again. Words you find easy come back less often. Words you keep forgetting come back sooner. Over time, you spend your study time exactly where it matters.
plus_how_body_2: Plus users get a personal Due today list built from this data — a short, focused session of only the words your memory needs right now. No guessing, no wasted repetition.
plus_cta_heading: Not ready to wait? Start with Free today.
plus_cta_body: All your progress carries over to Plus automatically when you upgrade.
norskproven_subheading: Norskprøven is the official Norwegian language exam — required for permanent residency and citizenship. Practice the vocabulary that actually appears on the test, organised by CEFR level.
norskproven_fact_who_text: Required for permanent residency and Norwegian citizenship.
norskproven_fact_target_text: B1 oral and written for citizenship. A2 is the minimum for permanent residency.
norskproven_fact_tests_text: Listening, reading, writing, and speaking — all in real-life everyday situations.
norskproven_fact_register_text: Tests run throughout the year at Folkeuniversitetet and other approved test centres.
norskproven_a2_description: These categories cover everyday situations tested in the Norskprøven written and oral exam at A2 level.
norskproven_b1_description: B1 is the target level for Norwegian citizenship. These categories are important for the written test and the oral interview.
norskproven_browse_all: browse all {level} categories on the home page
norskproven_tip_1_text: — even if you think you are at B1, gaps in A2 vocabulary will cost you points on the written test.
norskproven_tip_2_text: — rating cards as Again, Hard, Good, or Easy builds a personal schedule so you review difficult words more often.
norskproven_tip_3_strong: Focus on health, work, and housing
norskproven_tip_3_text: — these three topic areas appear in almost every Norskprøven oral scenario.
norskproven_tip_4_text: — the My Progress page shows your CEFR estimate and which categories still need work.
norskproven_cta_body: Pick a category above, flip through the cards, and rate each one. Your progress is saved automatically.
